title: Check changed files when context is used
statement:
When context is requested or checked, observe the current revision, staged changes, working files, deletions and nonignored new files. Include canonical Projector records and exclude disposable runtime state. Distinguish unchanged, changed, no previous observation and incomplete observation; report bounded paths and limitations. Repeated observation must preserve unresolved findings.

Validate retained knowledge before reuse. Changed files justify scoped reconsideration, not a claim of semantic drift. Quiet session instructions may explain the workflow; do not rescan the checkout or inject repeated reminders at each prompt or tool call. Use the current task and existing authorization to decide whether deeper investigation is needed.
rationale: Replace mandatory prompt/session observer hooks with demand-driven checks. Preserve bounded observation, uncertainty and unresolved findings.

title: Investigate drift with focused evidence
statement:
For an authorized investigation, compare saved reasoning dependencies with current evidence. Without saved dependencies, inspect current design and state that files alone cannot reconstruct historical intent. Return concise findings, source references and concrete consequences. Investigation alone does not authorize repair or new accepted meaning; use the authorization already given for the task.

Delegate separable work when it reduces context or review cost. Coordinate overlapping files and decisions before writes. Keep material unresolved questions visible, continue independent work and ask only for information or authority that is actually missing. Update an existing finding when new evidence arrives.
rationale: Remove compulsory subagents and UI-specific question routing. Preserve evidence, authorization, coordination and uncertainty.

title: Detect external changes before reusing context

steps.statement: A retained context exists for a checkout.
Another tool changes the checkout, then the agent requests, resumes or checks the retained context.
Observe the current state and identify affected dependencies before reuse. Preserve unaffected conclusions and unresolved findings; explain incomplete observation.
Treat a changed commit as proof of semantic drift, silently reuse stale context, or interrupt work with repeated prompt and tool reminders.

rationale: Preserve external-change detection at the point of reuse without the retired prompt hook.

title: Keep investigation questions focused

steps.statement: The user has authorized an investigation.
The investigator finds a consequential unresolved choice or an overlapping write.

Explain the choice and its evidence concisely, coordinate overlap, and continue independent work. Request user input only when the missing decision exceeds existing authority or cannot be resolved from available evidence.
Infer historical intent from files alone, require delegation for every investigation, or require the user to repeat authorization already given.

rationale: Keep the useful coordination and uncertainty behavior without prescribing one host UI or delegation ceremony.

title: Exercise the package as installed

steps.statement: The release package and plugin have been assembled from verified source.
Exercise their public commands in a fresh ordinary repository with workspace module resolution removed.
Initialization, context retrieval, canonical preview/apply, checks, inspection and read-only resumption work using the bundled runtime. Retain the exact package and observed results.
Claim that successful compilation or a copied source checkout proves the installed package works. Treat test isolation as a mandatory product confinement backend.

rationale: Retire a specific CI lane, certificate and traceability protocol. Keep direct evidence that the actual distribution works independently of source dependency resolution.

title: Recover interrupted writes without replaying authority

steps.statement: A controlled change has current exact approval and an authenticated journal.
The applying process tree stops after durable target mutation and before completion.

A fresh process can inspect the retained invocation, journal and authority. Explicit recovery restores the journaled consistent state only after ownership is established. Preserve ambiguity as recovery-required.

A subsequent explicit apply rechecks exact plan authority and current dependencies. Reject a substituted hash, changed validator, out-of-scope write or stale dependency. An unrelated change may rebind only through the existing dependency rules.
Independent validation uses its authenticated source bytes. A completed apply retains its receipt; repeated explicit application returns the same completed result without duplicating work.
Resume silently recovers, applies changes, renews authority or hides unavailable evidence.
Represent native execution or disposable test isolation as protection against hostile same-user access.

rationale: Preserve the exact authority, interruption, provenance and idempotence invariants; remove duplicated harness instructions and the old resume-as-apply behavior.
